notes: Current Chablis specification homologated by arrêté of 10 September 2025. Chablis is white still wine exclusively from Chardonnay. Premier Cru uses distinct maturity, yield and total-alcohol limits. The conditional fermentable-sugar allowance to 4 g/L is conservatively fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until the acidity condition is represented. The specification does not establish a Chablis-specific minimum élevage or consumer-release calendar, so no Grand Cru calendar rule is imported by analogy.
